description: Explains one EU or national rule in detail, for example the PPWR authorised representative for packaging, the PPWR declaration of conformity, the GPSR EU responsible person, the EUR 3 customs duty on low-value parcels, KSeF or Spanish B2B e-invoicing, the online withdrawal button, toy warnings or the cosmetics responsible person: what it requires, who must do it, where it applies, start date and deadline, whether a change or postponement of the law is pending, open questions and official sources. Input: a rule_id as listed by list_markets_and_categories or returned by eu_obligations_checklist (for example eu-ppwr-epr-authorised-representative). It explains one known rule; it does not work out which rules apply to a shop.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier, e.g. "eu-ppwr-epr-authorised-representative", "eu-gpsr-responsible-person" or "pl-einvoice-ksef"; listed by list_markets_and_categories and returned by eu_obligations_checklist

name: explain_obligation
title: Explain one obligation
